_setupNotes: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Settings > Import). 2. Set env vars in n8n Settings > Environment Variables. 3. SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = service_role key from Supabase dashboard. 4. Cron fires at 14:00 UTC = 09:00 America/New_York (EST). For EDT (summer), update cron to '0 13 * * *'. 5. Cost benchmarks in the Code node mirror the seeded defaults in migration 20260312120000_add_job_cost_benchmarks.sql — keep them in sync if benchmarks are updated. 6. Activate the workflow after setting all env vars.
